 Vivo will launch the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India later this month, and a new red colour option has already been teased
 by Sagnik Das Gupta Published: 12 November 2026, 14:56 IST Add as preferred source Share Image Credit: X/ @Vivo India
 Summary
 The Vivo X500 series will launch in India on November 26, 2026, alongside the Vivo Watch GT2 smartwatch.
 The lineup is expected to include the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max, all with ZEISS-tuned cameras.
 A new teaser shows a red Vivo X500 that wasn’t offered in China, Europe or Southeast Asia.
 After teasing the Vivo X500 series India launch recently, the brand has now confirmed that the flagship lineup will launch in India on November 26, 2026 . It is expected to include the Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max, which continue Vivo’s camera partnership with ZEISS. 
 Vivo X500 Series Will Arrive in a New Red Colourway
 The official Vivo India X account confirmed the launch date and also revealed that the Vivo Watch GT 2 will go official at the same event. Additionally, the brand has shared a short teaser that shows what appears to be the base Vivo X500 in three colourways.
 One of them is a new red finish and this colour option wasn't offered when the Vivo X500 launched in China . Neither does it appear to be available in Europe or any other region. Vivo hasn't said whether the red variant will be exclusive to India. 
 The Vivo X500 Pro Max is the top model in the series, with a ZEISS TrueDynamic main camera and a telephoto system that can keep tracking moving subjects while recording video. 
 The Vivo X500 Pro offers flagship cameras in a more compact body. The standard X500 has a floating camera module design and ZEISS-tuned colour profiles.
 Vivo will also sell an X500 Pro Max Photographer Kit and a Vivo Imaging Grip Kit in India. Vivo has already teased that the Vivo X500 series will arrive with a ZEISS telephoto extender marked "400mm equivalent".

 Although the official pricing is obviously under wraps, tipster Sanju Choudhary took to X to share the leaked Vivo X500 series price. According to the tipster, here's how the phones will be priced:
 Vivo X500 price in India 
 12 GB + 256 GB variant: Rs 1,19,999 
 Vivo X500 Pro price in India 
 12 GB + 256 GB variant: Rs 1,49,999 
 Vivo X500 Pro Max price in India 
 12 GB + 256 GB variant: Rs 1,59,999 
 12 GB + 512 GB variant: Rs 1,79,999 
 Additionally, the tipster also suggests that the Vivo X500 series will go on sale in India from December 2, 2026.
 That said, the Vivo Watch GT2 will launch at the same event as well. As per leaks , it features a 2.07-inch display and offers up to 25 days of battery life on a single charge. It also supports continuous health and activity tracking and works with Vivo’s wider device ecosystem.
 The Vivo X500 India launch is one of several big phone launches lined up for the second half of November, so stay tuned as we'll have full India pricing and availability on November 26.
